findings.finding: Physical clicking an own Inspector popup menu item outside the normal window was rejected as covered before delivery.
findings.fix: Recognize own menu/menu-item ancestry in the AX hit, with matching process identity and the existing expected-node check. Other own hits retain normal-window and overlay checks.

findings.finding: A subsequent live attempt was interrupted by a focus change and the filtered idle monitor returned below 300 seconds.
findings.scope: This run did not establish a search/filter result. Shared input stopped and the task-owned Inspector was later closed without foreground input.

findings.finding: After repeated reopen, the Inspector AX frame no longer matched its rendered WindowServer frame; one broader diagnostic read exceeded the client timeout.
findings.fix: Create a fresh Inspector controller after close, disable ordering animations, publish passive frame readiness, bound AX reads between messages and keep passive Inspector/pointer recovery off the action queue.

findings.finding: The first fixture-control count changed from 16 to 17 after activation/enhanced Accessibility.
findings.scope: The test now reacquires current fixture controls rather than treating the startup count as a fixed UI contract. This is a test correction, not a claimed app defect.
